curated.category: 遗传性血液病与血红蛋白病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 患者体内血红蛋白β链基因（HBB）突变导致红细胞在缺氧或脱水时变成僵硬的“镰刀状”，极易堵塞全身微血管并迅速破裂溶血; 2) 最致命的急性危象包括急性胸部综合征（ACS，数小时至数天内进展为重度低氧血症和呼吸衰竭）、脑卒中、脾脏急剧滞留性休克及爆发性败血症（因功能性无脾，5岁以下儿童感染肺炎链球菌可在数小时内致命）; 3) 即使平时看似稳定，一次发热、脱水或高海拔缺氧即可诱发致命危象。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 目前已进入“功能性治愈”新时代：2023年底全球首个CRISPR基因编辑疗法Exagamglogene autotemcel（Casgevy）和慢病毒基因疗法Lovotibeglogene autotemcel（Lyfgenia）相继获FDA批准，可让90%以上重度患者摆脱血管闭塞危象；异基因造血干细胞移植也可根治部分儿童患者。日常长期口服羟基脲（Hydroxyurea）可显著减少危象发作并延长寿命，但基因疗法价格高昂且对国内及全球多数患者仍难及。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021全因超额死亡归因模型估算全球年总死亡约37.6万例（其中5岁以下儿童约8.11万例）；若仅统计死因证明直接登记的狭义死因约为3.44万例

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国为极罕见输入性/散发病例，国家死因监测未单列死亡人数；国内主要集中于华南、西南及涉外通婚家系

epidemiology.prevalence_global: GBD 2021估算全球现患病例约774万例，年新发出生患儿约51.5万例（近80%在撒哈拉以南非洲，Lancet Haematol 2023）

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 突发剧烈骨痛、胸痛、呼吸急促、高热（≥38.5℃）或突发偏瘫/言语不清，立即拨打120送往有血液科与急救能力的医院，切勿在家硬扛止痛; 2) 急诊第一时间予以吸氧维持血氧饱和度、静脉补液纠正脱水、强效镇痛（阿片类药物，避免过度脱水）及广谱静脉抗生素覆盖（如头孢曲松）; 3) 出现急性胸部综合征、血红蛋白骤降或急性卒中时，立即行红细胞置换输血（将HbS降至30%以下），严禁盲目大量单纯输血导致血液黏稠度飙升。

master.definition_en: BAP1-related tumor predisposition syndrome (TPDS) is an inherited cancer-predisposing syndrome, associated with germline mutations in BAP1 tumor suppressor gene. master.definition_en: Lethal left ventricular non-compaction-seizures-hypotonia-cataract-developmental delay syndrome is rare, genetic, neurometabolic disease characterized by global developmental delay, severe hypotonia, seizures, cataracts, cardiomyopathy (including left or bi-ventricular hypertrophy, dilated cardiomyopathy) and left ventricular non-compaction, typically resulting in infantile or early-childhood death. Patients usually present metabolic lactic acidosis, failure to thrive, head lag, respiratory problems and decrease in respiratory chain complex activity. Highly variable cerebral abnormalities have been reported and include microcephaly, prominent extra-axial cerebrospinal fluid spaces, diffuse neuronal loss and cortical/white matter gliosis.

master.definition_en: Hydrops fetalis is a severe and challenging fetal condition usually defined as the excessive accumulation of fetal fluid within the fetal extravascular compartments and body cavities that manifests as edema, pleural and pericardial effusion and ascites. It is the end-stage of a wide variety of disorders. The cause may be immunologic (immune hydrops fetalis, IHF) or non immunologic (non-immune hydrops fetalis, NIHF), depending on the presence or absence of maternal antibodies against fetal red cell antigens (ABO incompatibility or rhesus (Rh) incompatibility).

master.definition_en: Coloboma of inferior eyelid is a rare developmental defect during embryogenesis characterized by a unilateral or bilateral, partial or full-thickness, variably sized defect of the inferior eyelid (ranging from a small notch to complete absence of the entire lid) which is usually triangular in shape (with base at eyelid margin) and located on the lateral third of the lid. master.definition_en: A group of autoimmune conditions characterized by inflammation of the limbic system and other parts of the brain.The cardinal sign of limbic encephalitis is a severe impairment of short-term memory; however,symptoms may also include confusion, psychiatric symptoms, and seizures.The symptomstypically develop over a few weeks or months, but they may evolve over a few days. Limbic encephalitis is often associated with an underlying neoplasm (paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis); however some cases never have a neoplasm identified (non-paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis). Delayed diagnosis is common, but improvements are being made to assist in early detection. Various tests including imaging studies (MRI, PET) laboratory tests (CSF analysis), and tests that measure the electrical activity of the brain (EEG) may be utilized to confirm a diagnosis. Treatment includes removal of the neoplasm (if identified) and immunotherapy.

master.definition_en: A rare vaginal malformation characterized by the presence of a complete or incomplete septum dividing the vagina into two parallel cavities, resulting from failure of reabsorption of the midline uterine septum between the two fused Müllerian ducts during embryogenesis. Patients are often asymptomatic, but may present with menorrhagia, dysmenorrhea, dyspareunia, infertility, or spontaneous abortion. The condition may occur as an isolated malformation or in association with other Müllerian duct anomalies (such as septate uterus or uterus didelphys) or renal abnormalities.

master.definition_en: A rare ophthalmic disorder characterized by inflammation of the posterior uveal tract (retina and choroid), due to an infectious etiology. Presenting symptoms are decreased visual acuity, visual field defects, floaters, photopsia, photophobia, and occasionally pain. Signs on examination include conjunctival injection, keratic precipitates, retrolental cells, inflammatory infiltrates on the retina, macular edema, and peripheral retinal neovascularization, among others. Complications (such as cataracts, band keratopathy, glaucoma, cystoid macula edema, and retinal detachment) may lead to permanent vision loss.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。
